key: Any single spin of the roulette wheel
name: ch00_casino_house_edge
alt: A casino roulette table where one player celebrates a win while the house manager calmly watches a huge ledger of thousands of spins tilted slightly in the house's favour.
scene: A wide interior view of a glittering casino floor at night, warm golden chandeliers overhead and deep green felt tables stretching into the background. In the foreground centre, a roulette wheel spins with a small white ball mid-bounce. On the left, a young man in his late 20s wearing a shiny maroon kurta-style shirt throws both arms up in delight as the croupier, a woman in her 30s in a black waistcoat and bow tie, slides a small stack of chips toward him; his two friends clap behind him. On the right, standing calmly behind a polished wooden podium, the house manager, a grey-haired man in his 50s in a navy suit with reading glasses, does not even look at the celebration; he is studying a very long paper ledger that unrolls off the podium and spills across the floor in a long ribbon, covered in hundreds of tiny tick marks. Above the ledger floats an inset bubble showing a tall pile of chips on a balance scale tipping very slightly toward a side marked with a small house icon. A thin curved arrow runs from the single winning player to the long ledger, showing that one spin is swallowed by the pile. Lighting is warm and theatrical on the player, cooler and steady on the manager. Labels: "ONE TRADE" above the cheering player, "THE EDGE" beside the tipping scale bubble, "THOUSANDS OF TRADES" along the unrolled ledger.

key: On your back, feet downstream
name: ch00_river_feet_downstream
alt: Two swimmers in a fast river: one floats calmly on his back feet-first past a rock, the other is frozen clinging to the rock as water piles up around him.
scene: A dramatic side-on view of a fast Himalayan river in a rocky gorge after the monsoon, brown-green water rushing from left to right with white foam, pine trees and grey cliffs in the background under a bright but cloudy sky. In the mid-ground sits a large dark boulder splitting the current. On the left half, a calm swimmer in his 30s wearing an orange life jacket and a white helmet floats on his back, feet pointing downstream and slightly raised, arms out to steer, face relaxed and focused; a dotted curved arrow shows his planned path sliding around the boulder with the current. Above him a small inset bubble shows a hand writing on a notepad before the trip with a checkmark. On the right half, just past the boulder, a second swimmer of similar age in a blue life jacket is pinned against the rock, clutching it with both arms, eyes wide and jaw clenched, water piling up white against his back and growing waves around him, with a small swirl of frantic motion lines above his head. A long bold arrow sweeps along the whole river from left to right to show the unstoppable current. Labels: "TREND" on the long river arrow, "STOP-LOSS PLANNED" above the floating swimmer, "FREEZING" above the swimmer stuck on the rock.

key: A speedboat and an oil tanker
name: ch01_speedboat_and_tanker
alt: In a busy harbour a giant oil tanker turns in a slow wide arc while a small speedboat zips nimbly beside it, its driver looking distracted at his phone.
scene: An elevated three-quarter view over a busy Indian port harbour at morning, cranes and stacked shipping containers lining the far shore, gulls in the sky and soft hazy sunlight on calm blue water. Dominating the left and centre is a huge dark-red oil tanker making a very slow, wide turn; a long dotted curved arrow traces its enormous turning circle across the water, and on the dock a small crowd of dock workers in hard hats point at it, clearly able to see where it is going. On the right foreground, a small white speedboat cuts a tight, sharp U-shaped wake in the water, showing it can turn on a coin. Its driver is a man in his early 30s in a T-shirt and sunglasses, one hand loosely on the wheel and the other holding a phone, eyes on the screen rather than the water, his expression careless. A small inset bubble near the speedboat shows the same driver later, sweating and wide-eyed, gripping the wheel with both hands. The sea around the speedboat is perfectly calm, making the point that the water is not the danger. Labels: "BIG FUND" on the tanker hull area beside it, "YOU" above the speedboat, "THE DANGER IS THE DRIVER" floating near the inset bubble.

key: A crowded cinema with one exit
name: ch01_cinema_one_exit
alt: A packed single-screen cinema where a wisp of smoke appears and the whole audience surges toward a single narrow exit door at once.
scene: A wide view from the back of a crowded old single-screen Indian cinema hall, rows of red velvet seats sloping down toward a glowing screen showing a bright film scene. A thin grey curl of smoke rises from near the front corner. The audience, a mix of families, college students in jeans, an older uncle in a white kurta and a mother holding a toddler, has just risen from their seats; faces show sudden alarm, popcorn tubs tip over, and everyone is surging toward one narrow green-lit exit door on the right wall. Bold arrows from all across the hall bend and converge into a single thick arrow squeezing through the doorway, showing the rush concentrating into one point. Nobody is holding money or bargaining; one man in the aisle is shown leaving his seat with a ticket still in hand, ignoring a small sign on the seat back. In the far left, the projectionist in a small window looks down in surprise. Lighting is dim and warm from the screen with a cool green glow from the exit sign. Labels: "SMOKE" next to the curl of smoke, "ONE EXIT" above the door, "THE MOVE" along the thick converging arrow.

key: A pilot whose engine fails
name: ch01_pilot_nearest_airport
alt: A small plane with a smoking engine is shown two ways: one pilot diverts to the nearby airport, the other keeps flying toward a faraway city.
scene: A split-panel scene divided by a thin vertical line, showing the same small white twin-engine propeller plane flying over green fields and a winding river, with one engine trailing grey smoke. LEFT panel: inside the cockpit view inset, a calm woman pilot in her 40s in a white shirt with epaulettes speaks into her headset with a steady expression, and outside a dotted arrow curves the plane gently down toward a small nearby airstrip with a windsock and a short runway just below; ground crew wave a welcome. RIGHT panel: the same plane with smoke now heavier, its pilot, a man in his 30s with a tight jaw and sweat on his forehead, staring stubbornly ahead; a long dotted arrow stretches far past the nearby airstrip toward a tiny distant city skyline on the horizon with a little flag, the path getting fainter and more jagged as it goes. A road sign in the fields of the right panel points back toward the nearby airstrip, ignored. Light is clear midday, calm on the left, darker clouds gathering on the right. Labels: "STOP HIT" near the smoking engine, "NEAREST AIRPORT" over the small airstrip on the left, "ORIGINAL PLAN" over the distant city on the right.

key: Packaging is the last stage of a trend
name: ch01_trend_on_supermarket_shelf
alt: A trend travels from a busy street food stall to a fancy cafe to a supermarket freezer, by which time the trendy crowd has moved to a new stall.
scene: A left-to-right timeline scene across a single long city street, like a horizontal strip. On the far left, a small street-food cart with a hand-painted board selling a new kind of fusion momo, crowded with excited college students in hoodies taking photos with their phones, steam rising. In the middle, a stylish cafe with big glass windows serves the same momo on slate plates to well-dressed office workers, the crowd a little older and smaller. On the right, a bright supermarket aisle with a long freezer full of identical shrink-wrapped boxes of the same momo, stacked under a sale tag, with a lone tired shopper in his 40s pushing a trolley past it with mild indifference. Above the street a thick arrow runs from left to right showing the trend's journey, getting thinner as it moves right. Tucked into the top right corner, the original college students have moved on to a new cart with a different dish and are again crowding and photographing it. Lighting goes from lively warm evening glow on the left to flat fluorescent white on the right. Labels: "EARLY" above the street cart, "PACKAGED = LATE" above the supermarket freezer, "NEXT TREND" beside the students at the new cart.

key: A dog on a lead walks in a wobbly line
name: ch02_dog_short_vs_long_lead
alt: The same owner walks a dog twice: on a very short lead the dog is yanked back at every sniff, on a longer lead it wanders and reaches the park.
scene: A split-panel scene divided down the middle, set on a leafy Indian residential lane with low compound walls, bougainvillea and a parked scooter. The same owner, a woman in her late 20s in a kurta with jeans and sports shoes, walks the same cheerful brown indie dog in both halves. LEFT panel: the dog is on a very short lead, barely an arm's length, tied to a metal post by the gate; every time it leans to sniff a lamp post or a fallen leaf, the lead snaps taut and a small jerk-lines effect shows it being yanked back; the dog looks confused and the owner frowns with a 'failed' look. A tiny ruler icon by the lead reads "30 cm". RIGHT panel: the lead is long and loose; the dog zig-zags in a wobbly dotted path, sniffing a lamp post, a flowerpot and a cat on a wall, yet the dotted path steadily heads forward to a green park gate with swings visible beyond. The owner holds a smaller handbag than in the left panel, hinting she brought less. A small inset bubble shows two coins in the left panel and one coin in the right panel. Soft warm morning light and long shadows. Labels: "TIGHT STOP" at the top of the left panel, "WIDER STOP, HALF SIZE" at the top of the right panel.

key: Each setup is a team; each block
name: ch02_setup_league_table
alt: A cricket league table board at a local ground where team names are trading setups, one being promoted and one beloved losing team being relegated.
scene: A sunny afternoon at a local cricket ground in an Indian town, a big painted wooden scoreboard standing at the boundary rope. The board is a league table with rows of team names painted on slats and simple columns of wins and losses. A groundsman in his 50s in a white vest and khaki shorts stands on a ladder, sliding one slat to the top while another slat is being lowered into a bin labelled with a downward arrow. In the foreground left, a young trader in his late 20s in a cricket jersey over a T-shirt holds a clipboard, ticking off a block of 25 small boxes, a calm judging expression. In the foreground right, the same trader's friend, wearing the jersey of the losing team with a painted face, clutches a flag of the bottom team with puppy-eyed devotion while the team's slat sits at the very bottom with zero wins. In the background, small players in whites play on a green pitch. Lighting is bright and clear with long afternoon shadows. Labels: "SETUPS = TEAMS" across the top of the scoreboard, "25 TRADES = 1 SEASON" beside the clipboard, "IMPULSE TRADES" above the bottom slat held by the devoted fan.

key: Holding a kite on a gusty day
name: ch02_kite_grip_gusty_day
alt: Three kite flyers on a rooftop during a festival: one grips too tight and the string snaps, one lets out too much and the kite drifts low, one adjusts the grip and the kite flies steady.
scene: A rooftop scene on a crowded Gujarati-style terrace during the kite festival, colourful kites dotting a bright windy sky, neighbouring rooftops packed with families, a spool stand and a plate of snacks on a parapet. Three flyers stand left to right, wind lines blowing across the frame from the left. LEFT: a teenage boy in a striped T-shirt holds the string in a white-knuckled fist, the string pulled straight; a gust arrow hits his kite and the string snaps with a small burst, the kite tumbling away, his face shocked. CENTRE: a middle-aged man in a vest and lungi has let out a huge loose loop of string from his spool, and his kite has drifted far down toward a distant water tank, sagging, while he only now starts reeling in, worried. RIGHT: a calm young woman in her late 20s in a cotton kurta and sunglasses holds the string with a relaxed but firm grip, giving a little line with each gust; her kite flies high and steady, a small gust meter icon floating beside her. Lighting is crisp winter sunlight. Labels: "TOO TIGHT" above the boy, "TOO LOOSE" above the man, "MATCH THE WIND" above the woman.

key: Throw 25 darts at a wall, then draw
name: ch02_darts_bullseye_drawn_after
alt: A man draws a bullseye around his luckiest dart after throwing, while a ghostly next dart lands somewhere else entirely.
scene: An interior scene in a small college hostel room with a bare cream-coloured wall, a bunk bed at the left edge and a poster-free notice board. Twenty-five darts are scattered across the wall in a random spray, some high, some low, a few on the floor. In the centre, a young man in his early 20s in shorts and a hostel T-shirt, standing on tiptoe with a marker pen, is carefully drawing neat red-and-white bullseye circles around one dart that happened to land alone in a blank patch; he looks very pleased with himself. His roommate sits on the lower bunk in the foreground left, arms folded, sceptical eyebrow raised. On the right side of the wall, a semi-transparent ghost dart is mid-flight with a dotted trajectory arrow, about to land far away from the freshly drawn bullseye, near a light switch. A small inset bubble in the upper right shows a calendar page flipping forward to tomorrow. Lighting is a plain overhead tube light with a warm desk lamp glow. Labels: "IN-SAMPLE" next to the drawn bullseye, "OUT-OF-SAMPLE" next to the ghost dart, "DRAWN AFTER" with a small arrow pointing at the marker pen.

key: A trader who is long reads every bullish
name: ch03_selective_news_reading
alt: A trader reads a newspaper through tinted glasses that only let him see the happy headlines, while the gloomy half of the page fades out.
scene: A cosy morning scene on a small balcony of a city apartment, a cutting-chai glass and a plate of biscuits on a little plastic table, potted tulsi plant, distant rooftops behind. A man in his mid 30s in a vest and pyjamas sits on a plastic chair reading a large spread newspaper and holding a tablet on his knee. He wears special glasses with one lens tinted green. Through his eyes, a sweep of dotted sight lines lands on the page: the headlines with small upward arrows glow brightly and are circled in green highlighter, while the headlines with small downward arrows are greyed out, blurred and faded as if invisible. On the floor next to him, a pile of the past month's newspapers is stacked high, each with only the green headlines cut out and pinned onto a corkboard on the wall behind him that is now completely covered in upward-arrow clippings. His expression is smug and certain. A tiny inset bubble shows the actual newspaper page from a neutral view: exactly half green arrows and half red arrows. Soft early morning light. Labels: "MY POSITION: LONG" on a sticky note on the tablet, "WHAT HE SEES" over the corkboard, "WHAT THE FEED SAYS" over the neutral inset.

key: A boat tied to a dock with an elastic
name: ch03_boat_elastic_rope_dock
alt: A small fishing boat tied to a dock by a stretchy elastic rope drifts far on a stormy wave but is pulled back toward the dock.
scene: A coastal Kerala backwater-meets-sea harbour scene, coconut palms bending in the wind, grey storm clouds overhead with a band of sunlight breaking through at the right. A sturdy wooden dock juts out from the left side of the frame, with a fisherman in his 50s in a checked lungi and a towel on his head watching calmly, arms folded. A brightly painted wooden fishing boat with an eye motif on its bow is tied to a post on the dock by a thick, visibly stretchy elastic rope, the kind with coiled texture. A tall wave on the right has pushed the boat far out to sea, and the elastic rope is stretched very long and thin, almost straining. Bold curved arrows from the waves point outward, while a strong arrow along the rope points back toward the dock, larger the further the boat has drifted. Ghost outlines of the boat at closer positions, from near the dock to far out, show its earlier drift path. Lighting is moody with patches of sunlight. Labels: "MOVING AVERAGE" on the dock post, "PRICE" on the boat, "PULL BACK" along the stretched rope arrow.

key: Prices take the stairs up and the lift
name: ch03_stairs_up_lift_down
alt: In an office building, people climb the stairs one by one on the way up, while a jam-packed lift plunges down with everyone crammed in.
scene: A cutaway cross-section of a six-storey Indian office building, like a dollhouse with the front wall removed. On the left half, a wide staircase zig-zags upward floor by floor; individual people climb it one at a time with spacing between them: a young man in a formal shirt carrying a laptop bag, an older woman in a saree holding a file, a delivery boy with a parcel, each pausing on landings to decide and then continuing, a gentle dotted arrow tracing the slow zig-zag climb. On the right half, a lift shaft runs top to bottom; the glass lift car is crammed to bursting with the same type of office workers squeezed shoulder to shoulder, hair flying upward and faces alarmed, plunging down fast with speed lines and a bold straight down-arrow beside the shaft. At the ground floor, a single narrow exit door has a small queue already forming. Lighting is fluorescent office light with a calm warm tone on the staircase side and a harsher tone on the lift side. Labels: "UP: ONE BY ONE" along the staircase, "DOWN: ALL AT ONCE" beside the lift shaft.

key: An option is a melting ice cube
name: ch03_option_melting_ice_cube
alt: A block of ice with a price tag melts on a hot street over several days, shrinking faster as a calendar approaches its last day.
scene: A hot summer street outside an old-style ice factory in an Indian town, sun blazing in a pale blue sky, heat shimmer above the road. Left to right, a row of five identical wooden handcarts is lined up like a time sequence, each carrying a block of ice with a paper price tag tied on with string. A calendar above each cart shows the days ticking down, the last showing a big red circle around the final day. The first block is big and glossy, the second slightly smaller with a few drips, the third smaller with a puddle, the fourth much smaller with a bigger puddle, and the fifth is just a tiny sliver in a large pool of water. The ice vendor, a lean man in his 40s with a towel over his shoulder and a vest, walks alongside the carts looking more anxious at each step. Beside the row, a contrasting neat steel almirah with a stack of share certificates on top sits in the shade untouched and unchanged, with a small sign saying "FREE TO WAIT". Droplet icons drip faster near the end. Labels: "OPTION" above the first ice block, "TIME DECAY" along the row of puddles, "EXPIRY" above the last cart.

key: Buying an option is buying a ticket
name: ch04_ticket_vs_contract
alt: A concert-goer holds just a ticket while beside him a man signs a long contract for the whole venue that is catching fire.
scene: A split-panel scene outside a large outdoor concert ground at dusk, string lights and a stage visible in the background. LEFT panel: a cheerful college student in his early 20s in a denim jacket holds up a single paper ticket at the entrance gate; a small price tag dangles from it, and a thought bubble shows his worst case as only that ticket torn in half, with a relaxed shrug. RIGHT panel: at a folding table, a nervous man in his 40s in a formal shirt with loosened tie is signing a very long legal contract that unrolls off the table onto the ground, while in the background behind him the stage roof has caught fire with orange flames and smoke; a long bill with many zeros is floating over his head and an arrow from the fire points to the bill. In a small inset at the bottom right, a third character, a woman in her 30s, sells tickets from a booth but has a safety net strung beneath her booth, hinting at a hedged seller. Lighting is warm golden on the left and red-orange from the fire on the right. Labels: "BUY OPTION: MAX LOSS = TICKET" above the left panel, "FUTURES: YOU OWE THE BILL" above the right panel, "SPREAD" beside the safety net inset.

key: call is a car that already has
name: ch04_car_fuel_petrol_station
alt: Two cars on a highway: one already has fuel in its tank, the other is empty and must be pushed a long way to the petrol station and beyond.
scene: A sunny national highway scene running left to right across the frame, flat fields of mustard on both sides and a roadside petrol station with a canopy and pumps visible far on the right, plus a small finish flag further beyond it. In the left foreground, a compact white hatchback is parked with its fuel gauge visible in an inset bubble showing the needle well above empty; its owner, a smiling man in his 30s in a polo shirt, leans on the door holding the keys, relaxed. In the middle of the road, a second identical hatchback sits empty, its inset fuel gauge showing the needle on E. Behind it, a sweating young man in a vest and track pants is pushing it with both hands, face straining, and a long dotted arrow stretches from the car to the petrol station, then continues further to the little flag beyond the station. Mile marker stones along the road count the distance. Heat shimmer and harsh noon light. Labels: "IN THE MONEY" above the first car, "OUT OF THE MONEY" above the pushed car, "BREAK-EVEN" beside the flag past the petrol station.

key: An umbrella seller outside a stadium
name: ch04_umbrella_seller_storm_forecast
alt: Outside a cricket stadium an umbrella seller charges triple as dark clouds gather, then sits unsold under clear skies after the storm passes.
scene: A split-panel scene outside a large cricket stadium in an Indian city, floodlight towers and fans in team-coloured jerseys streaming toward the gates. LEFT panel: heavy dark monsoon clouds roll in overhead, a small phone screen in a fan's hand shows a storm cloud icon, and a wiry umbrella vendor in his 40s in a faded shirt and cap stands beside a cart of black and colourful umbrellas; a crowd of fans jostles to buy, waving notes, while he flips a hand-written price card upward with a cheeky grin and an arrow showing the price tripling. RIGHT panel: same spot, same vendor, same umbrellas, but the sky is now clear blue with the sun out and puddles drying; fans walk past without looking, the price card has been flipped back down, and the vendor sits on an upturned crate with his chin in his hand, bored. A small inset between panels shows identical umbrellas side by side to stress nothing about them changed. Lighting is dark and electric on the left and bright and flat on the right. Labels: "HIGH IV" above the left panel, "IV CRUSH" above the right panel, "SAME UMBRELLA" beside the inset.

key: Picking up coins in front of a
name: ch04_coins_before_steamroller
alt: A man scoops up tiny coins directly in front of an advancing road roller, while another picks up larger coins from a safe distance to the side.
scene: A long road under construction on the edge of an Indian town, fresh black tar steaming, orange cones and a few labourers in the background. A big yellow road roller rumbles from the left toward the right, its heavy drum filling the left third of the frame, a driver in a cap seated high up looking ahead. Directly in front of the drum, on the tar, a man in his late 20s in a cheap shirt is crouched, rapidly scooping up hundreds of tiny shiny coins into a cloth bag, smiling greedily and not looking back; he is only a step ahead of the drum, motion lines showing the roller closing in. Off to the right side, a step beyond the edge of the roller's path on the dusty shoulder, a calm woman in her 30s in a salwar kameez picks up a few larger, heavier coins at a slower pace, keeping one eye on the roller. A dotted line marks the edge of the roller's path on the ground. Hot afternoon light and dust in the air. Labels: "FAR-OTM SPREADS" above the crouching man, "ATM SPREADS" above the woman, "THE BIG LOSS" on the roller drum.

key: Never go out without a homing beacon
name: ch05_taxi_hotel_card
alt: A lost traveller in a foreign city taxi hands the confused driver a hotel card written in the local script, and the driver smiles and nods.
scene: An interior view from the back seat of a neat foreign city taxi at dawn, the driver in white gloves and a peaked cap turned halfway around in his seat. Through the windshield, a pale early-morning city street with tall glass buildings, unfamiliar shop signs in a foreign script rendered as abstract squiggles, and a distant fish market's roof with crates stacked outside. In the back seat, a tired foreign businessman in his 40s in a crumpled blazer, conference lanyard around his neck and a small rolling suitcase beside him, holds out a small white business card printed in the local script toward the driver. A thought bubble above him shows a tangle of failed attempts: a speech balloon with a big question mark and crossed-out words. Above the driver a matching bubble now shows a simple hotel building icon with a checkmark, and he is nodding with a relieved smile. On the dashboard, a small compass-like homing beacon icon glows next to the card. Soft pink dawn light through the windows. Labels: "PRE-PLANNED EXIT" beside the hotel card, "NOT KNOWING THE LANGUAGE" above the businessman's tangled thought bubble.

key: sitting under a tree with a loaded gun
name: ch05_patient_hunter_under_tree
alt: A patient hunter sits quietly under a tree with only a few bullets, while a tired impatient hunter nearby has an empty belt after shooting at everything.
scene: A forest-edge clearing at golden hour, tall sal trees, long grass and a stream in the background, with small birds and a rabbit visible in the grass. In the left foreground, a calm hunter in his 40s in khaki clothes and a wide-brimmed hat sits with his back against a large tree trunk, a rifle resting across his knees, his ammunition belt still full of bullets; his eyes are alert and steady, looking toward the far clearing where a large deer is just stepping out of the trees. A dotted sight line runs from him to the deer. On the right side of the frame, a second hunter of similar age sits slumped on a stump, sweaty and exhausted, his belt completely empty, spent shell casings scattered all around his boots, and small puffs of smoke and missed shots marked on tree trunks and a scared rabbit; he only now notices the deer, with drooping eyelids and a too-late expression. A small inset bubble near him shows an empty wallet. Warm low sunlight with long shadows. Labels: "WAIT FOR THE SETUP" above the patient hunter, "BOREDOM TRADES" above the tired hunter, "REAL OPPORTUNITY" near the deer.

key: Each square is a stock. $TICK asks
name: ch05_market_tile_board_questions
alt: A giant wall of lit-up square tiles, each a stock, with three inspectors asking different questions about the same board.
scene: A grand stock exchange hall with high ceilings and tall windows, a huge wall at the back covered in a grid of hundreds of square light tiles, each glowing either green or red, like a stadium card display. In the foreground, three inspectors stand facing the wall, each with a different tool. LEFT: a young woman in her 20s in a crisp shirt holds a stopwatch and a clicker counter, glancing at the board right now, with a speech bubble showing a lightning bolt and the words "RIGHT NOW". CENTRE: an older man in his 60s in a sleeveless jacket holds a long paper roll comparing today with a pinned photo of yesterday's board, with a speech bubble showing a small calendar. RIGHT: a man in his 30s with a flashlight shines it on thick pipes running behind the tiles, where blue liquid flows toward some tiles more than others, with a speech bubble showing a water drop. Thin lines connect each inspector to the same wall. Lighting is dramatic with the wall glowing. Labels: "$TICK" above the woman, "$ADD" above the older man, "VOLUME FLOW" above the man with the flashlight.

key: No rule fired; Steve was nervous
name: ch05_nervous_finger_on_sell
alt: Two traders at side-by-side desks: one calmly checks a written rule card while the other nervously presses the sell button too early.
scene: A small trading room with two adjacent desks under a window showing a city at mid-morning, each desk with twin monitors showing blurred blocky charts, coffee mugs and notepads. On the left desk, a calm, experienced trader in his 50s in a rolled-sleeve shirt leans back with arms folded, glancing at a laminated rule card taped to his monitor that has three empty checkboxes with none ticked; a small clock shows only five minutes have passed. On the right desk, a younger trader in his 30s in a hoodie leans forward, sweaty, eyebrows knitted, his index finger jabbing a big red button on his keyboard, a jittery shaking effect around his hand. A thought bubble above him shows a ghostly monster shape labelled with a question mark, the fear of the unknown. A small inset bubble between them shows the calm trader quietly asking a question with an open palm and the nervous trader admitting with a sheepish expression. Morning light falls across both desks. Labels: "RULE: NOT TRIGGERED" beside the rule card, "FEAR" above the nervous trader's thought bubble.

key: A paper account is a flight simulator
name: ch06_flight_simulator_vs_real_plane
alt: A trainee pilot is calm in a flight simulator, then gripping the controls with a knot in her stomach in a real cockpit.
scene: A split-panel scene divided by a thin vertical line, the same trainee pilot in both halves: a woman in her early 30s with her hair tied back, white pilot shirt and headset. LEFT panel: inside a dim training room, she sits in a flight simulator cockpit mounted on hydraulic legs, the screen showing a pixel-perfect runway; she is relaxed and smiling, coffee mug on a side tray, an instructor in his 50s with a clipboard giving a thumbs-up behind her; a little sign on the wall shows a joystick icon. RIGHT panel: in a real small aircraft cockpit, with real clouds and a real city far below through the windscreen, she grips the yoke with both hands, knuckles white, shoulders up, a bead of sweat on her temple; a stylised knot is drawn glowing over her stomach area, and a small cash-bundle icon floats beside the plane to show real money aboard. The instruments and checklist in both panels are identical. Lighting is cool and artificial in the simulator and bright, intense daylight in the real cockpit. Labels: "PAPER ACCOUNT" at the top of the left panel, "REAL MONEY" at the top of the right panel, "THE FEELING" next to the knot over her stomach.

key: A shop losing money. You don
name: ch06_kirana_till_receipts
alt: A kirana shop owner sorts his till receipts by product and discovers two product lines lose money on every sale.
scene: An interior view of a small, crowded Indian kirana shop at night after closing, shelves stacked with rice sacks, biscuit packets, soap, and jars of sweets, a single bulb hanging from the ceiling. Behind the wooden counter, the shop owner, a man in his 50s with a moustache, half-rim glasses, white banian and checked lungi, has emptied a steel cash box full of paper till receipts and is sorting them into small piles on the counter, each pile weighed down by a product: a bar of soap, a packet of biscuits, a bottle of oil, a pack of instant noodles, and a box of candles. Two of the piles have small red minus signs floating above them and the receipts are stamped with tiny red arrows. His teenage son in a school uniform peeks over his shoulder with a calculator. In the background, two shelves holding those two losing products have a red price-cut tag on one and a cardboard sign reading "STOP" on the other. A thought bubble above the owner shows a magnifying glass over a single receipt. Warm yellow bulb light and deep night shadows. Labels: "JOURNAL BY SETUP" above the receipt piles, "CUT LOSERS" above the two marked shelves.

key: Buying a train ticket. Book early
name: ch06_train_ticket_early_vs_chasing
alt: One passenger booked early and sits relaxed in a train for a long cheap ride, while another sprints down the platform as the doors close, paying full price for a short ride.
scene: A busy Indian railway station platform in the morning, a long blue express train with open doors, a yellow station signboard, tea vendors with kettles and porters in red shirts carrying luggage. On the left, through a train window, a relaxed woman in her 30s in a cotton saree sits by the window with a paper ticket and a tiffin box, smiling; a long dotted arrow stretches ahead from her window along the track to a distant station far down the line, showing the long ride she has ahead; a small price tag beside her ticket is tiny. On the right, a frantic man in his 30s in office clothes with a tie flapping and a laptop bag bouncing is sprinting along the platform toward a door that is just closing, waving a crumpled ticket bought at the counter with a large price tag hanging off it, and the dotted arrow from his door is very short, ending at the next station sign just a little ahead. A big platform clock overhead shows the departure minute. Bright morning light with steam from a chai kettle. Labels: "ENTRY NEAR STOP" above the relaxed passenger, "CHASING" above the running man.

key: Three roads: a motorway (trend
name: ch06_three_roads_market_types
alt: The same small car drives on three roads: a smooth highway, a potholed street and a crowded car park, struggling with the same driving style on two of them.
scene: A wide triptych scene divided into three vertical panels, the same small red hatchback driven by the same young woman in her late 20s in a yellow kurta in each. LEFT panel: a broad, smooth expressway curving through green hills, the car cruising with a long straight speed-line trail, the driver relaxed with one hand on the wheel and the window down. CENTRE panel: a narrow monsoon-soaked city street full of deep potholes and puddles, autorickshaws and a stray cow, the car bouncing violently up and down with zig-zag motion lines, the driver's head bumping the roof and coffee spilling from a cup. RIGHT panel: a crowded mall car park with cars packed in, the hatchback creeping forward only a few centimetres, a parking attendant in uniform waving it on slowly, the driver yawning with her chin on her hand. A small inset at the bottom shows the same gear stick in all three, stuck in top gear. Lighting is bright sun on the left, grey rain on the centre, flat fluorescent under the car park roof on the right. Labels: "TREND" over the left panel, "CHOP" over the centre panel, "CONSOLIDATION" over the right panel.

key: can be done by bus, train or car
name: ch07_pune_by_bus_train_car
alt: Three travellers head to the same city signpost by bus, by train and by car, each with a different ticket price and a different worry about running late.
scene: A wide landscape scene of the Western Ghats in the monsoon, green hills with waterfalls, and a big green highway signpost in the far right pointing toward a distant city skyline with the word "PUNE" on it. Three routes run left to right toward that sign. TOP: a red state transport bus winding along a ghat road, a college student in a window seat holding a cheap paper ticket and a small backpack, relaxed but checking the time. MIDDLE: a blue express train crossing a stone viaduct over a gorge, a businessman in his 40s in a formal shirt inside with a printed e-ticket showing a mid price, reading a newspaper. BOTTOM: a white sedan on the expressway driven by a woman in her 30s in sunglasses, a fuel gauge and a toll receipt with a higher price on the dashboard, a little clock icon showing a traffic jam warning ahead. Each route has a small price tag and a small hazard icon: a breakdown triangle, a delay clock, a traffic cone. All three dotted arrows converge on the same signpost. Misty, fresh monsoon light. Labels: "SAME SIGNAL" above the signpost, "SHARE / FUTURE / OPTION" as a small caption under the three routes.

key: A vending machine that pays you
name: ch07_vending_machine_eats_100
alt: A man happily collects small coins from a vending machine again and again until one day it swallows a big note.
scene: An office corridor in an Indian tech park with tiled floors and a water cooler, a tall glossy vending machine glowing in the centre. A comic-strip arrangement fills the frame: across the top, a row of small repeated mini-panels shows the same young office worker in his late 20s in a lanyard and formal shirt grinning as a single small coin drops out of the machine into his palm, again and again, a tally of many small tick marks building up on a sticky note on the side of the machine. In the large main panel below, the same man feeds a big crisp banknote into the slot and the machine's slot has turned into a cartoonish mouth gobbling it up, with a crunch effect, while the man stares in disbelief with his jaw dropped and the sticky note of tally marks falls to the floor. A small balance-scale inset at the lower right compares a pile of many tiny coins on one side against the one big note on the other, tipping toward the note. Bright fluorescent office lighting. Labels: "MANY SMALL WINS" over the row of mini-panels, "ONE BIG LOSS" over the gobbled note, "NET: LOSS" next to the scale.

key: a car going uphill on an empty tank
name: ch07_car_uphill_full_vs_empty_tank
alt: Two cars climb the same steep hill: one with a full tank rolls over the top, the other with an empty tank stalls and rolls back down.
scene: A side-on view of a steep winding hill road in the Nilgiris, tea gardens in neat rows on either side, a blue sky with drifting clouds and a small temple at the summit. Two identical small white SUVs are on the road. On the right, nearly at the crest, one SUV powers over the top; an inset gauge bubble shows its fuel needle on full, and thick blue fuel pipes from a large tanker labelled with a volume icon pour into it. Its driver, a confident man in his 40s, leans forward smiling. On the left, partway up the slope, the second SUV has stalled; its inset gauge shows empty, and it is rolling backward down the hill, a curved dotted arrow showing it returning to the bottom where it started, near a roadside chai stall. Its driver, a younger man in his late 20s, looks back over his shoulder in alarm. Near the stalled car, a loudspeaker on a pole blares a speech bubble full of exclamation marks to represent loud news, while it does nothing to push the car. Bright clear daylight. Labels: "REAL VOLUME" on the fuel tanker pipes, "HEAD FAKE" above the rolling-back car, "NEWS" beside the loudspeaker.

key: A crowd rushes for the exit because
name: ch07_buy_seats_false_fire_alarm
alt: In an auditorium a crowd rushes out on a false fire alarm while one calm man buys up their seats, then the crowd rushes back to find only his seats left.
scene: A two-panel scene stacked top and bottom inside a large wedding hall turned into a concert auditorium, with chandeliers, marigold garlands and rows of chairs facing a stage. TOP panel: someone at the back has shouted, a speech bubble with the word "FIRE!" in it, and the crowd of guests in colourful sarees and kurtas is stampeding toward the doors with arms flailing, chairs knocked over, while in the middle a calm man in his 40s in a crisp white kurta and spectacles sits at a little table buying seat tickets from people as they run past, coins and slips changing hands, a neat stack of tickets growing in front of him. A small bubble near the ceiling shows a harmless steaming samosa pan, the actual source of the smoke. BOTTOM panel: the crowd realises there is no fire and rushes back in through the doors, but every remaining seat has a small paper slip with the calm man's tick on it, and he sits in the front row with arms crossed, smiling, as people line up to buy seats back from him. Warm golden indoor lighting. Labels: "PANIC GAP" over the top panel, "FILL BACK" over the bottom panel.

key: Bus stops on a road. On a trend day
name: ch08_bus_stops_trend_vs_chop
alt: A city bus drives one way stopping briefly at each stop on a trend day, while on a chop day it shuttles back and forth between just two stops.
scene: A split-panel scene stacked top and bottom, both showing the same straight city road with numbered bus shelters, neem trees and shops along the footpath. TOP panel: a red city bus drives steadily from left to right, a long solid arrow ahead of it, pausing briefly at each shelter in turn; a young commuter in his 20s with a backpack hops on at the shelter the bus has just left behind, waving cheerfully, while ghosted bus outlines at earlier shelters show it never turned back. BOTTOM panel: the same bus shuttles back and forth between only two shelters, with a looping double-headed arrow between them; the bus driver, a moustached man in his 50s in a khaki uniform, looks bored. A woman in her 30s in office wear boards at the left shelter and a little dotted path shows her stepping off at the right shelter, satisfied, then boarding again to go back. Behind both buses, a shop signboard shows the shelters numbered like levels. Midday light, busy but cheerful. Labels: "TREND DAY" at the top of the top panel, "CHOP DAY" at the top of the bottom panel, "PIVOT LEVELS" beside the row of shelters.

key: Standing one step in front of where
name: ch08_ticket_window_queue_front
alt: At a railway ticket counter, a crowd forms right at the window while one person stands a step ahead of where the crowd forms and is served first.
scene: A busy morning at an old railway reservation counter hall, a row of barred wooden ticket windows with a large clock above showing two minutes before nine and a closed shutter on the main window. A thick crowd of people is jostling right at the window bars: a man in a dhoti waving a form, two college students arguing, a woman with a toddler on her hip, an office man holding his file over his head, all elbows and shoulders. Just slightly in front of where this crowd has formed, positioned by a painted yellow floor line, a calm woman in her 30s in a simple salwar kameez with a cloth bag stands patiently with her form already filled out, first in place. A thought bubble above her shows the window shutter rising and her being served instantly. A small dotted arrow shows the crowd still arriving from the entrance, some not even reaching the window yet. On the right, an inset shows the shutter opening and her ticket being stamped. Bright morning light streams in through high windows with dust in the air. Labels: "THE LEVEL" beside the window, "ORDER JUST IN FRONT" above the calm woman, "THE CROWD" over the jostling group.

key: Two fishermen. One casts toward a fast
name: ch08_two_fishermen_river_vs_pond
alt: Two fishermen use the same rod: one lets the current carry his bait downstream in a fast river, the other takes quick small catches from a still pond.
scene: A split landscape scene in rural India divided by a gentle grassy ridge in the middle. LEFT side: a fast, wide river flows from top left toward the bottom, rocky banks and bamboo groves, a fisherman in his 40s in a faded blue shirt and rolled-up trousers stands on a rock and has cast his line far downstream; a long dotted arrow follows his bait as the current carries it toward a distant bend where a big fish waits, and he leans back patiently with the rod held loose. RIGHT side: a calm, still village pond with lotus leaves and a buffalo cooling in the far corner, a second fisherman of similar age in a vest and gamcha towel sits on the stone steps, flicking short quick casts and pulling in small silvery fish one after another into a steel bucket beside him, little splash marks and a loop arrow showing the repeated cast-catch cycle. Both rods are identical, connected by a small inset bubble showing the same rod twice with an equals sign. Bright mid-morning light with reflections on water. Labels: "TREND RULES" over the river, "CHOP RULES" over the pond, "SAME ROD" beside the inset bubble.

key: Stair-climbing with a handrail
name: ch08_handrail_step_by_step
alt: A climber moves up a steep stone stairway, always sliding her hand onto the handrail at the step she has just left.
scene: A steep stone stairway climbing a hill to a hilltop temple, the kind with hundreds of worn steps, a painted metal handrail running alongside, monkeys perched on the wall and pilgrims far ahead near the temple gate. In the centre, a woman in her 50s in a bright green saree with a cloth bag over her shoulder climbs carefully, one foot on a higher step, her right hand gripping the handrail at the level of the step she has just left behind. Ghosted transparent copies of her hand appear lower on the rail at earlier positions, each with a small upward arrow showing the hand moving up one step at a time. Each step she has passed has a small brass marker plate. To the right, a younger man in a T-shirt tries to leap two steps ahead while letting go of the rail, arms flailing, wobbling backward, a small red warning symbol beside him. In the background, the stairway disappears into soft morning mist with sun rays breaking through. Labels: "STOP MOVES UP" along the ghosted hand positions, "LEVEL BROKEN" at the step just behind her, "NEVER LET GO" near the wobbling man.

key: A stadium crowd doing a wave
name: ch09_stadium_wave_peak
alt: A packed cricket stadium crowd is mid-wave with two-thirds of fans standing at once, and the first fans are already starting to sit down.
scene: A sweeping wide view of a huge packed cricket stadium under evening floodlights, the green oval field and the pitch in the centre, tiny players in coloured kits paused between overs. The curved stands fill the frame, crowded with fans in team jerseys, painted faces, flags and horns. A Mexican wave is at its peak: about two-thirds of the stand, spanning from left across the centre, is on its feet with arms raised high, while at the left edge the first section of fans who stood earliest are now sitting back down, and at the far right edge only a few are left to rise. A big curved arrow sweeps over the crowd from right to left showing the wave's travel, and a smaller downward arrow over the left section shows people sitting. In the foreground, a calm spectator in his 30s in a cap stays seated, holding a small hand-held counter and smiling knowingly, while his excited friend beside him jumps up late with popcorn flying. A giant screen in the corner shows a gauge needle pinned near its maximum. Lighting is bright white floodlights against a deep blue dusk sky. Labels: "+1,000 TICK" on the giant screen gauge, "PEAK" above the standing crowd, "FADE" above the sitting-down section.

key: A queue that forms outside a shop
name: ch09_queue_because_of_queue
alt: A long queue snakes outside a sweet shop because people joined a queue, while inside the shopkeeper is down to the last few boxes.
scene: A bustling old-city market lane in the evening before a festival, string lights and marigold garlands above, a famous sweet shop with a glass display counter on the right side of the frame. A very long queue snakes out of the shop door and down the lane toward the left, people of every kind: a grandmother with a cloth bag, two office boys on phones, a man on a scooter who has just parked and is hurrying to join, a teenager asking the person ahead what the queue is for with a speech bubble containing a question mark. The newest arrivals at the far left end of the line look eager and excited. Inside the shop, visible through the glass, the shopkeeper, a plump man in his 50s in a white kurta with a pencil behind his ear, is lifting out the last three sweet boxes from nearly empty shelves, a worried look on his face, and a cardboard sign is half-written on the counter. A ruler-like measuring tape runs along the length of the queue on the ground with markings. Warm festive evening light. Labels: "$TICK = LINE LENGTH" along the measuring tape, "LATE BUYERS" above the newest arrivals, "SOLD OUT SOON" above the shopkeeper.

key: Waves at a beach versus a river
name: ch09_beach_backwash_vs_river
alt: On a beach every wave runs up the sand and back down, while in a river the rushing water never comes back past a waiting person.
scene: A split-panel scene divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a gentle Goa beach at late afternoon, coconut palms and a fishing boat on the sand, a wave running up the sand with foam, a curved arrow showing it climbing the beach and another curved arrow showing it running back down into the sea; a relaxed man in his 30s in shorts stands ankle-deep, confidently betting on the backwash with a small coin flip in his hand and a grin, little footprints washing away. RIGHT panel: a swollen river in full monsoon flood in the hills, muddy water rushing past from left to right with a single straight bold arrow, a broken branch carried away downstream; a woman in her 30s in a raincoat stands on the riverbank holding the same small coin, with a cautious, wary expression, watching the splash disappear downstream with no backwash arrow. In both panels, an identical splash of water hits the person's feet, highlighted with a matching small burst. Lighting is warm golden on the left and grey and rainy on the right. Labels: "RANGE DAY" at the top of the left panel, "TREND DAY" at the top of the right panel, "SAME SPLASH" between the two highlighted splashes.

key: A thermometer during a fever
name: ch09_fever_thermometer_readings
alt: A mother checks a child's fever hour after hour, writing the high readings on a chart, and waits for a clear downturn before relaxing.
scene: A cosy but worried night-time bedroom scene in an Indian home, a ceiling fan turning slowly, a small bedside lamp casting warm light. A young boy of about eight lies in bed under a patterned quilt with a wet cloth on his forehead, flushed cheeks, sleeping uneasily. His mother, in her 30s in a nightdress with a shawl around her shoulders, sits on the edge of the bed holding a digital thermometer up to the lamp, squinting at it with concern. On the bedside table is a steel glass of water, a strip of medicine and a notebook where she has written a column of readings with the hours beside them; a small inset bubble shows the notebook close-up with a row of high numbers and a hand-drawn line staying high, and only at the bottom one slightly lower reading. The father, in his 30s in a T-shirt, stands in the doorway holding a phone ready to call a doctor. A wall clock reads three in the morning. A small dotted arrow from the single lower reading points to a question mark rather than a checkmark. Labels: "ONE SPIKE" beside the first reading, "SUSTAINED READINGS" along the notebook column, "WAIT FOR THE TURN" near the question mark.

key: A dog on an elastic lead. The owner
name: ch10_dog_elastic_lead_owner
alt: An owner walks steadily while a playful dog on an elastic lead runs ahead and lags behind, the lead stretching only so far before pulling it back.
scene: A wide side view along the seafront promenade of Marine Drive at sunrise, the curved sea wall, joggers and a few morning walkers in the background, the sea calm and pink-tinted. In the centre, a steady walker, a fit man in his 60s in a white tracksuit and cap, walks at an even pace from left to right with a thin straight dotted line trailing his path at waist height. He holds a bright yellow elastic lead attached to a playful golden retriever. Multiple transparent ghost copies of the dog are drawn around him: one far ahead at the full stretch of the lead with the lead thin and taut, one lagging behind sniffing a lamp post with the lead stretched backward, and one right at his heels. Curved arrows show the lead pulling the far-ahead dog back toward him and, in one small inset, the man speeding up a step to catch up. A small measuring tape icon on the lead shows the typical stretch distance. Soft pink sunrise light and long shadows across the promenade. Labels: "AVERAGE" above the walking man, "PRICE" above the farthest dog, "1 ATR" along the measuring tape on the lead.

key: A child and an adult both walk
name: ch10_stride_child_vs_adult
alt: A child and an adult each take a few steps away from a lamp post, the adult ending up much further away, with distance measured in footprints.
scene: A quiet park path at sunset lined with neem trees and benches, an old cast-iron lamp post standing on the left side of the frame as the starting point. Two walkers set off from the lamp post at the same time, walking to the right. On the upper path, a small girl of about six in a frock and sandals takes five short steps, her footprints drawn on the path as small coloured prints with numbers one to five, ending close to the lamp post. On the lower path, her father, a tall man in his late 30s in a kurta and jeans, takes five long strides with large numbered footprints, ending far down the path near a bench. A metre measuring tape runs along the ground under both, showing very different distances, and above each walker a small bubble counts strides instead, both reading five. A stylised inset in the top right shows two markets as animals: a calm tortoise and a bounding deer, each with their own stride marks. Warm orange sunset light. Labels: "SAME 5 STRIDES" above the two counting bubbles, "ATR = STRIDE" beside the footprints, "QUIET VS WILD" beside the animal inset.

key: Fishing with a net sized for small
name: ch10_net_torn_by_shark
alt: Fishermen pull small fish from a coastal net, but a shark fin is approaching and an old fisherman signals to pull the net out of the water.
scene: A wide coastal scene at a fishing village in Tamil Nadu in the morning, a long sandy beach with colourful wooden boats pulled up, coconut palms, drying nets and a pale blue sea. In the shallow water, three fishermen in checked lungis and head towels are hauling a fine-mesh net heavy with small silvery fish, smiling and working in rhythm, a basket of fish already full on the sand. Out beyond them in the water, a large grey shark fin is cutting toward the net, with a dotted path arrow leading straight to it. A small inset on the right shows what happens if they wait: the same net torn open with a big ragged hole and the basket of fish spilling back into the sea. On the beach, an elderly fisherman in his 70s with a white beard stands on an upturned boat, pointing urgently at the fin and waving his arm toward the shore, his mouth open in a shout. A watchtower flag flaps a warning. Lighting is bright clear morning with sparkling water. Labels: "SMALL RTM TRADES" above the net of small fish, "SQUEEZE" beside the shark fin, "PULL THE NET" near the old fisherman.

key: Two gears on one machine. In normal
name: ch10_two_gears_one_machine
alt: An old flour mill machine has a small fast gear turning normally, and a big gear engaging while the small one is disconnected by a lever.
scene: An interior view of an old village flour mill, the chakki, with whitewashed walls dusted in flour, sacks of wheat stacked on the left and sunlight pouring through a small window. In the centre stands a large cast-iron machine with two exposed gears side by side on one shaft: a small, fast-spinning gear with quick motion lines on the left, and a large heavy gear on the right. A belt runs from a motor to the shaft. The mill operator, a man in his 50s with flour on his vest and a white cap, is pulling a long lever with both hands. A two-step sequence is shown: in the main picture the big gear has just engaged, turning slowly and powerfully with large arcing motion arrows, while the small gear is slid out of mesh with a small gap and a pause symbol beside it. An inset bubble in the top left shows the earlier normal state: the small gear spinning, the big gear idle. A woman customer in a saree waits with a steel container, watching flour pour faster out of a chute. Warm dusty light. Labels: "1-ATR TRADES" on the small gear, "SQUEEZE" on the big gear, "DISENGAGED" beside the gap.

key: A rubber band and a spring
name: ch11_rubber_band_vs_spring
alt: A hand holds a stretched rubber band that wants to snap back, while another hand presses down a coiled spring that is about to jump.
scene: A clean, close-up tabletop scene on a wooden workbench in a small electronics repair shop, tools hanging on a pegboard behind and a soldering iron resting on its stand. Two hands of a repairman in his 40s are the main subjects, his checked shirt sleeves rolled up. LEFT: his left hand stretches a thick rubber band far out from a nail hammered into the bench, the band thin and taut, with a curved arrow showing it about to snap back to the nail; a small dotted line marks the nail as the resting point. RIGHT: his right thumb presses down hard on top of a coiled metal spring standing upright on the bench, the coils squeezed tightly together, with a small gauge showing compression; above it a big upward burst arrow with motion lines shows where it will jump as soon as the thumb lifts. Between the two, a small inset shows two different tools on the pegboard, a measuring tape and a pressure gauge, each linked by a thin line to one of the hands. Warm workshop light. Labels: "STRETCHED = SNAP BACK" above the rubber band, "COILED = JUMP" above the spring, "DIFFERENT TOOLS" by the inset.

key: A surfer paddles out and waits past
name: ch11_surfer_positioned_early
alt: One surfer sits on her board beyond the breakers waiting calmly as a big wave arrives, while another is still running across the sand, too late.
scene: A wide seascape at a surf beach on the Karnataka coast, a rocky point on the right, a lighthouse on a hill and a soft cloudy sky. A large swell is rising in the background, its curling crest just forming. Beyond the breaking line in calm water, a young woman in her 20s in a rash vest sits upright on her surfboard, legs dangling in the water, relaxed and patient, looking back over her shoulder at the rising swell; a gentle dotted arc shows the path she will take down the face of the wave. She has clearly been waiting a while: a small bored yawning bubble is drawn beside her. On the beach in the foreground, a young man in board shorts sprints across the sand carrying his board under his arm, sand flying from his feet, mouth open and eyes on the wave, a long dotted line showing how far he still has to paddle through breaking white water. A lifeguard tower with a flag stands to the left. Soft late-morning light with spray glinting. Labels: "POSITIONED" above the waiting surfer, "TOO LATE" above the running man, "THE MOVE" on the rising wave.

key: A starting pistol at a race
name: ch11_starting_pistol_squeeze_fires
alt: Sprinters crouch in their blocks on a track while the starter raises a pistol, then one runner bursts off at the gun and later slows as her legs tire.
scene: A school sports day at a district athletics stadium, a red running track with white lanes, a small crowd of parents and students with banners in a simple concrete stand. A three-stage sequence runs left to right. LEFT: four teenage sprinters in vests and shorts crouch in their starting blocks, a referee in a white shirt and cap holding up a starter pistol; a small bubble above reads "ON YOUR MARKS" and a row of dark dots floats above the runners. CENTRE: the pistol fires with a puff of smoke and a bright burst, a single hollow grey dot appears above, and the lead runner, a girl in a yellow vest, explodes forward in the direction she is facing, a bold forward arrow under her. RIGHT: further down the track, the same girl's stride shortens, her face showing fatigue, and a small arrow pointing down appears over a speed bar, while she eases up before any painted finish line, which is drawn faintly far beyond her. Bright midday light with dust on the track. Labels: "SQUEEZE" over the crouching runners, "FIRES" at the pistol burst, "MOMENTUM FADES" above the tiring runner.

key: A monthly squeeze is a volcano
name: ch11_volcano_geyser_kettle
alt: A distant volcano erupts massively, a nearby geyser shoots up in the middle ground, and in the foreground a small kettle whistles on a stove.
scene: A layered landscape composition with three clear depths. FAR BACKGROUND: a giant snow-capped volcano on the horizon releasing a huge eruption, a towering plume of ash and glowing lava visible from miles away, with tiny villagers on a distant ridge pointing at it. A calendar icon floating beside it shows many years flipping. MIDDLE GROUND: a rocky valley with steaming vents where a geyser shoots a tall column of hot water into the air, a few tourists with cameras standing at a safe railing, a small wall clock icon beside it showing a week. FOREGROUND: the open window of a small Himalayan tea shop on the left side of the frame, inside which a steel kettle sits on a gas stove whistling with a small jet of steam, a tea seller in his 40s in a woollen cap and muffler reaching for it with a cloth, a stopwatch icon beside the kettle showing minutes. Thin dotted lines link each of the three to a matching size of burst arrow. Crisp cold mountain light, warm orange glow from the volcano. Labels: "MONTHLY" beside the volcano, "WEEKLY" beside the geyser, "5-MINUTE" beside the kettle.

key: paddling a kayak down a river
name: ch12_kayak_eddies_river
alt: A kayaker paddles into a small upstream eddy beside a rock, but the whole river is clearly flowing downhill, carrying her onward.
scene: An overhead three-quarter view of a clear mountain river in Rishikesh, flowing from the top of the frame down toward the bottom, smooth boulders, white sand banks and green forested hills, a suspension footbridge faint in the far background. A huge, wide translucent arrow is painted along the whole river pointing downstream, showing the main flow. In the centre, a woman kayaker in her late 20s in a red helmet and yellow life jacket has paddled into a small swirling eddy behind a boulder; a little circular arrow inside the eddy curls upstream for a moment, and her paddle is mid-stroke, her face focused. A dotted path line shows where she came from upstream and continues past the eddy, swinging back into the main current further down. Below her, a ghosted outline of the same kayak sits much further downstream, showing where she will end up. On the bank, a guide in his 30s in a cap stands with a whistle, pointing downstream. Bright clear morning light, sparkles on the water. Labels: "5-MIN CHART" beside the small eddy, "HOURLY CHART" along the big river arrow.

key: Three people judge which way a crowd
name: ch12_three_judges_crowd_turn
alt: Three observers on a balcony watch a festival crowd turn, each looking back at a different number of steps, the quickest noticing first.
scene: A view from a heritage building balcony overlooking a broad street during a Ganesh festival procession, decorated with flags and flower garlands, drums and dancers in the crowd below. The crowd has just begun turning from walking right to walking left: footprints on the road show the newest steps curving around. On the balcony, three observers stand side by side, each with a different-length measuring rope hanging down to the road. LEFT: a young man in his 20s with a short rope covering only the last six footprints, already pointing left with an excited expression. CENTRE: a woman in her 40s with a medium rope covering fifteen footprints, raising her hand, about to agree. RIGHT: an elderly man in his 70s with a long rope covering thirty footprints, still looking the old way, thoughtfully stroking his beard. Above them, three small signal lamps sit on the railing: the first lit, the second lit, the third about to light. Warm festive evening light and colourful powder in the air. Labels: "FAST" above the young man, "MEDIUM" above the woman, "SLOW" above the elderly man.

key: A surfer catches a wave. The squeeze
name: ch12_surfer_two_exits
alt: A surfer rides a wave in two ways: one steps off entirely when the first push fades, while a second half stays riding the rolling swell toward the beach.
scene: A dynamic seascape at a sunny surf beach on the Kerala coast, coconut palms and a red-and-white lighthouse on the shore, a long rolling swell moving from right to left toward the beach. The same surfer, a young man in his 20s in a blue rash vest, is shown as two side-by-side figures riding the same wave, as if split in two. The first figure, near the back of the wave, steps off the board onto the water with a confident look as a small burst marking the first push fades behind him, a short arrow showing his ride is over. The second figure, slightly translucent like a half-weight version, keeps riding the board forward along the long swell, knees bent, arms out for balance, a long dotted arrow showing the ride continuing toward the beach. Below the water's surface, a broad, slow, deep blue wave shape is drawn rolling toward the shore, powering the board. A small inset in the corner shows the board stalled flat on calm water with a shrug and a zero sign. Bright late-morning light with spray. Labels: "EXIT 1" above the stepping-off figure, "EXIT 2" above the riding figure, "C WAVE" on the deep swell below.

key: Buying concert tickets as soon as the
name: ch12_concert_tickets_scale_in
alt: A fan quietly buys a few concert tickets at a time as rumours grow, then relaxes in front of a huge queue on the official sale day.
scene: A three-stage left-to-right scene. LEFT: a young woman in her mid 20s in a hoodie sits on her bed at night with her phone, a small rumour bubble on a poster on the wall showing a guitar and a question mark, and she buys two tickets, a small price tag beside her phone. CENTRE: a week later in a college canteen, friends excitedly show each other phones with bigger rumour bubbles and music notes, and she buys two more tickets, the price tag slightly higher. A rising stair of small price tags floats above stages one and two, each one slightly higher than the last, with a dotted average line drawn through them. RIGHT: on the official sale day, a gigantic queue of people snakes around a stadium wall in the hot sun, holding umbrellas and water bottles, and a big price tag above the ticket booth is far higher than her dotted average line. She walks past the queue relaxed, holding a fan of tickets, sunglasses on, smiling. Lighting goes from blue night to bright midday. Labels: "SCALE IN" above the rising price tags, "AVERAGE PRICE" on the dotted line, "BREAKOUT CROWD" over the queue.

key: You plant a tree and dig it up every
name: ch13_digging_up_the_sapling
alt: An impatient gardener digs up a sapling each time the wind bends it, while his neighbour's tree, left alone, has grown tall and full of fruit.
scene: A split-panel garden scene in an Indian village backyard, a mud wall between two plots. LEFT panel: a restless man in his 30s in a vest and shorts kneels with a spade, digging up a small mango sapling whose stem is bending in a gust of wind drawn with swirling lines; a row of small uprooted saplings lies wilting beside him, each with dirt still on the roots, and a basket labelled with a small tick mark holds only a few tiny leaves. His face is anxious. A little seed packet and an open bag of seeds sit near him to show planting is easy. RIGHT panel: his neighbour, a calm woman in her 50s in a cotton saree, sits on a charpai in the shade of a tall mango tree full of ripe fruit, a basket brimming with mangoes at her feet; ghost outlines show the same tree bending in past windy storms, with small dates showing time passing. A long curved arrow shows the tree growing from sapling to full tree through the windy days. Warm golden late-afternoon light. Labels: "EXITING EARLY" at the top of the left panel, "LET IT RUN" at the top of the right panel, "WINDY DAYS" near the ghost outlines.

key: A car brakes for a speed bump
name: ch13_car_brakes_speed_bump
alt: A car on a long highway briefly brakes at a speed bump, but a view of the whole road shows it is still clearly heading the same way.
scene: A long straight highway through flat Rajasthani desert with low scrub, sand dunes and a camel cart on the side, a clear blue sky. The road runs from the bottom left into the far distance at the top right. A white sedan is just going over a yellow-and-black painted speed bump, its brake lights glowing red, a small bump effect under its wheels. In a large zoomed inset bubble in the top left corner, only the last ten metres of road are shown: the car with bright brake lights, the bump and a big question mark, as if the car might be turning around. The main picture, by contrast, shows a long dotted trail of six evenly spaced ghost cars behind it, all heading the same way, plus a bold arrow continuing ahead to a distant town on the horizon. A middle-aged man in a turban at a roadside dhaba with a glass of tea in his hand watches the car calmly, unconcerned. Hot, bright desert midday light. Labels: "LAST BAR" above the zoomed inset, "SIX BARS" along the ghost car trail, "STILL THE SAME DIRECTION" beside the arrow ahead.

key: Half the position is the cash you bank
name: ch13_half_banked_half_free_ticket
alt: A traveller puts half his winnings into a bank locker and sleeps peacefully, then rides a joy-ride with a free ticket in hand.
scene: A two-part scene connected by a curved arrow. LEFT: a small-town bank branch counter, a cheerful man in his 30s in a formal shirt hands a bundle of cash to a teller in her 40s behind a glass window, and a small inset above him shows him later at night sleeping peacefully in bed under a blanket with a gentle smile and a moon in the window. RIGHT: at a busy fairground mela at dusk, the same man sits relaxed in a carriage of a big Ferris wheel lit with colourful bulbs, holding up a paper ticket stamped with a large zero, arms spread wide and laughing. A small sign at the ride entrance shows two red circles, representing the rule that ends the ride. Below the Ferris wheel, a safety net is strung at ground level under the carriage, hinting that the worst case is nothing lost. Other families, kids with cotton candy and balloon sellers, fill the background of the fair. Lighting goes from flat daylight in the bank to warm sparkling lights at the fair. Labels: "HALF BANKED" above the bank counter, "FREE TICKET" next to the zero ticket, "TWO-BAR EXIT" beside the sign at the ride entrance.

key: A big holder wants to buy more gold
name: ch13_mandi_stop_hunt
alt: At a wholesale market a big trader dumps a few sacks to cause brief panic, buys up cheap from fleeing sellers, then the price drifts back up.
scene: A busy grain mandi in north India at dawn, a vast covered shed with heaps of golden wheat, sacks stacked high and a large chalkboard price board hanging from a pillar. In the centre, a stout big trader in his 50s with a gold chain, white kurta and a shawl, sits on a pile of sacks with a quiet smile, while two of his helpers deliberately tip a few sacks off a cart with a loud thud and a cloud of dust, drawing everyone's attention. A downward arrow on the price board shows a short sharp drop. On the left, a crowd of small sellers in turbans and caps, who had set their own red-tagged limits on strings around their sacks, panic and push their sacks toward the big trader, each red tag snapping off as they cross a dotted line on the floor, while he calmly hands out cash and his helpers pile the sacks behind him. On the right, an inset shows an hour later: the price board arrow curving back up, the big trader sipping tea beside a much larger stack. Warm dawn light with floating dust. Labels: "STOP RUN" beside the snapping red tags, "BIG BUYER" above the trader, "PRICE RECOVERS" above the inset.

key: A tug-of-war rope with a marker
name: ch14_tug_of_war_marker
alt: A tug-of-war match at a school sports day, where a referee notes only where the rope's marker ends each round, and it ends closer to one team three rounds in a row.
scene: A dusty school playground on sports day, a chalk line drawn across the ground, coloured bunting, children and teachers watching from the side. Two teams of teenagers in different coloured house T-shirts, blue on the left and orange on the right, pull a thick rope, leaning back with gritted teeth, feet dug into the dirt. A bright red cloth marker hangs from the middle of the rope. In the foreground, a referee teacher in her 40s in a tracksuit with a whistle around her neck holds a clipboard, carefully noting only the marker's resting position at the end of each round with small tick marks, ignoring the wild swings in the middle of the round. Ghosted outlines of the marker show it yanked back and forth wildly during a round, in faint lines, while three solid flags pushed into the ground at the end of rounds one, two and three step steadily closer to the blue team's side. A small inset on her clipboard shows three closing positions in a row with an arrow. Bright morning sun, dust kicked up. Labels: "CLOSE ONLY" by the clipboard, "3 IN A ROW" above the three flags, "BUYERS" over the blue team.

key: A taxi meter. A time meter charges
name: ch14_time_meter_vs_distance_meter
alt: Two taxis: one meter ticks up while stuck at a red light, the other only ticks when the taxi is actually covering distance on an open road.
scene: A split-panel city scene divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a black-and-yellow taxi stuck in a jammed Kolkata junction at a red signal, surrounded by buses, handcarts and pedestrians; a large inset meter on the dashboard shows a clock icon with its numbers ticking up fast, and the passenger in the back, a woman in her 40s in a saree with a handbag, looks at the meter with annoyance while the taxi has not moved at all. RIGHT panel: the same type of taxi now flying down an open flyover with motion lines, a passenger, a man in his 30s with a laptop bag, sitting relaxed; the inset meter shows a road icon and the numbers advance only in step with small distance marks printed along the road beneath the wheels, each mark lining up with one tick of the meter. A small icon bubble in the right panel shows a stack of handshake trades filling up a counter before the next tick. Grey hazy light on the left and bright clear light on the right. Labels: "TIME CHART" at the top of the left panel, "TICK CHART" at the top of the right panel, "ONLY MOVES WITH BUSINESS" beside the right meter.

key: one shove of double strength takes it
name: ch14_swing_door_stop_and_reverse
alt: A waiter pushes a restaurant swing door in one smooth double-strength shove from fully open one way to fully open the other.
scene: A lively restaurant kitchen entrance at dinner time, a pair of wooden swing doors with round porthole windows separating the brightly lit steel kitchen on the right from the warm dining room with diners on the left. A waiter in his 20s in a white shirt, black waistcoat and bow tie, balancing a tray of steaming biryani plates on one hand, is mid-stride pushing the door with his shoulder. Ghost outlines of the door show it fully swung open toward the dining side, and a large curved double-thick arrow sweeps it in one continuous move all the way to fully open toward the kitchen side, with a bold double chevron on the arrow to show double strength. To the side, a small inset shows the wrong way: a confused trainee in a cap stopping the door halfway with his hand, the door stuck in the middle, then pushing it the other way with a little dotted two-step path and a red cross. A head chef in a tall white hat watches approvingly from the kitchen. Warm golden dining light on one side and bright white kitchen light on the other. Labels: "LONG" on the dining side, "SHORT" on the kitchen side, "ONE DOUBLE ORDER" along the big arrow.

key: A falling knife is still moving
name: ch14_falling_knife_handle
alt: A cook lets a falling knife hit the kitchen floor and stop bouncing, then safely picks it up by the handle.
scene: A close-up home kitchen scene in a South Indian house, a granite countertop with a coconut, a chopping board with half-cut vegetables, a pressure cooker on the stove and steel vessels on a rack. A large chef's knife has slipped off the counter and is shown in a vertical sequence of ghost images from the counter edge down to the tiled floor, spinning and gleaming, with motion lines. On the left, a young man in his 20s in a T-shirt lunges and reaches toward the mid-air blade with an open hand, a red warning burst near his fingers. On the right, his mother, in her 50s in a cotton nightie with a towel on her shoulder, stands still with her hands calmly behind her back, watching. At the floor, three small bounce marks with tiny numbers one, two and three show the knife bouncing off the tiles before coming to rest; a final inset shows her hand bending down to pick it up by the handle once it is completely still. Warm late-morning light through a window with a hanging plant. Labels: "STILL FALLING" beside the spinning knife, "3 BOUNCES" by the bounce marks, "NOW PICK IT UP" near her hand on the handle.
